gaps: GST percentages and landed-cost values cannot be set with the available operations, so the plan establishes only unit prices of 100 and 105.
The numeric rank values cannot be asserted because the available read_indicators field exposes only rank.best_bidder.
The buyer-screen label for the ranking basis cannot be read or asserted with the available fields.
what the screen shows (an API plan checks the data, not the page)

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round for a second QA vendor with 1 audience to add uuids.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit) for the invited QA vendor.
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 105 (open, price, submit) for a second QA vendor.
Wait until the round has closed (bid end and extra closing time over).
The buyer reads the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder).
